title: Entity detail page with cross-linked relationships
description:
The 'Wikipedia article' for each entity: a detail page showing all attributes in a clean info panel plus every relationship as clickable links grouped by relation. For a Yacht: builder, owner, designer, engine maker, region(s), tenders/subs, support vessel — each a link to that entity's page. For a Builder: all yachts BUILT_BY it (as a table), country. For a Region: all clubs/marinas/companies/yachts located there. Show source-file provenance. This turns the graph into a browsable, cross-referenced encyclopedia.

Part of Phase 2 (UI foundation). Delivers the 'relations' half of the goal via clickable traversal.
acceptance_criteria: Every node type has a detail route rendering its attributes in a readable panel
All relationships (both directions) are shown grouped by relation type as clickable links to related entities
Inverse relations render as tables where useful (e.g. a Builder page lists its yachts)
Provenance (source files) for the entity is displayed
Navigating entity->relation->entity works for at least a 3-hop path (Yacht->Builder->another Yacht)
